set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"

deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import asyncio,re
from telethon import TelegramClient
from scripts.userbot_session import load_credentials,SESSION_BASE
MARKS=("エリア", "ビデオChat", "ゲイのための掲示板")
PATTERN=re.compile(r'https://t.me/GayBBS_bot\?start=a_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32}')
async def main():
    a,h=load_credentials()
    async with TelegramClient(str(SESSION_BASE),a,h) as c:
        assert await c.is_user_authorized()
        matches=[]
        async for d in c.iter_dialogs(limit=200):
            if d.is_group and any(word in (d.name or "") for word in MARKS):
                matches.append(d)
        print("USERBOT_BOARD_DIALOG_COUNT="+str(len(matches)))
        found=0
        for dialog in matches:
            async for msg in c.iter_messages(dialog.entity,limit=120):
                text=(msg.raw_text or "")
                urls=[b.url for row in (msg.buttons or []) for b in row if getattr(b,"url",None)]
                if any(PATTERN.search(u) for u in urls) or PATTERN.search(text):
                    found+=1
        print("USERBOT_VISIBLE_ROOM_APPLICATION_LINKS="+str(found))
        if not matches:raise RuntimeError("USERBOT_NOT_A_MEMBER_OF_TARGET_GROUPS")
        if found==0:raise RuntimeError("NO_APPLICANT_LINK_VISIBLE_IN_RECENT_MESSAGES")
        print("USERBOT_REAL_ROOM_LINK_DISCOVERY_PASS")
asyncio.run(main())
PY
